text:
neo_marketing: quick sync  planning a product announce for Tue 10:00 PT. need final changelog link, docs URL, and a 1-line perf highlight for socials by EOD tomorrow. can we commit?

ravi_eng: changelog PR is queued, expect merge by EOD. docs are live in draft, needs a short product review. tagging @toni_product

toni_product: will review docs this afternoon and add a "what this means" bullet. webinar: do we keep the live demo Wed 11am PT or push later?

neo_marketing: live Wed 11am PT is preferred to ride the launch. marketing will run email + social in the first 24h.

maya_marketing: i'll write newsletter copy once changelog URL is final. need a 280-char line for the headline with a perf stat.

ravi_eng: short perf line: "~20% median latency improvement at 512 tokens; typical cost down ~25% with default batching + KV cache." drop-in draft.

alex_release: release rollout: canary starts 09:50 PT for checks, announce embargo lift at 10:05 PT, full traffic by 12:30 PT. ci-bot will kick the canary job.

ci-bot: Canary job scheduled: start=2026-07-14T09:50:00Z, pool=canary-4, alert-channel=#eng-oncall.

ravi_eng: docs link placeholder: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-07-infer-update. changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/483

neo_marketing: marketing asks changelog to include a short code example and migration note if anything breaks. can you add a curl snippet?

ravi_eng: will add two bullets and example curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rw1-medium","prompt":"hi"}'
```

toni_product: for the webinar slides, please include one slide on canary + rollback. @alex_release can you give two short rollback triggers?

alex_release: rollback triggers: sustained error rate > 1% for 5 minutes, or P95 latency > 2x baseline for 10 minutes. i'll paste exact wording into the shared doc by 5pm PT.

maya_marketing: social copy draft incoming. will post for engineering review before scheduling.

neo_marketing: recap: by EOD tomorrow we need changelog merged + docs reviewed + perf line. 09:50 PT canary precheck, embargo lift 10:05 PT, webinar Wed 11am PT. confirm here and i'll lock calendar.

ravi_eng: confirm from eng. merging PR now.

toni_product: confirmed. dropping webinar slides into drive and will update when ready.

maya_marketing: confirmed  will queue social & email once links are final.

ravi_eng: update: after one more perf pass the median improvement is 18% not 20%. updating PR and docs now.

maya_marketing: noted  will use 18% in the teaser. schedule stays.

neo_marketing: awesome, please prefix any further changes with "update:" in this thread so we catch them. thanks everyone :sparkles:
